notes.title: Eleven Sunrises – Major Milestone: Steam Achievements Now Live!
notes.notes:
I’m excited to share a major step forward in the development of Eleven Sunrises: Steam Achievements are now online!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699489/4b6d0cf9e77c59a2b2137d5bff29820cb8ece529.png[/img]

As a solo developer, every feature I implement is a significant milestone, and this one is no exception. Achievements bring an extra layer of challenge and progression, giving players new goals to reach as they navigate the harsh, unforgiving desert world of Eleven Sunrises.

Why This Matters
Adding achievements isn’t just about ticking off a list of objectives—it’s about deepening player engagement and making every moment in the game more rewarding. Each achievement represents a meaningful challenge, whether it’s mastering a mechanic, overcoming survival obstacles, or uncovering hidden secrets.

This update is also a big technical step for me as a solo dev. Integrating Eleven Sunrises with the Steam ecosystem brings the game one step closer to a full release and opens the door for future features like leaderboards, cloud saves, and more community-driven content.

What’s Next?
Now that achievements are live, I’m focusing on refining gameplay, improving mechanics, and making sure every detail contributes to an immersive experience. There’s still plenty to come, so stay tuned for more updates!
